# Strikethrough


## strikethrough

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete me
.
<p>~~delete me</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete me~~
.
<p><del>delete me</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete me~~~
.
<p>~~delete me~~~</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete me\~~~
.
<p><del>delete me~</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete \~\~ me~~
.
<p><del>delete ~~ me</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~delete [me~~](/)
.
<p><del>delete [me</del>](/)</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~[hello](/)~~
.
<p><del><a href="/">hello</a></del></p>
````````````````````````````````

## strikethrough code span

```````````````````````````````` example
~~before `x~~y` after~~
.
<p><del>before <code>x~~y</code> after</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~before ``x~~`y`` after~~
.
<p><del>before <code>x~~`y</code> after</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~before `x~~y` after
.
<p>~~before <code>x~~y</code> after</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~before \`x~~y`
.
<p><del>before `x</del>y`</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~before `x~~
.
<p><del>before `x</del></p>
````````````````````````````````
